subject.title: fix(zai): send user agent during endpoint detection

question: Should this PR wait for redacted live Z.AI Coding Plan endpoint-detection proof, or should maintainers accept the credential gap for this narrow source-level fix?
rationale: The contributor cannot run the live smoke without a Z.AI Coding Plan key, and tests alone do not satisfy the real-behavior proof gate for an external provider fix.

options.title: Require or provide live smoke proof
options.body: A maintainer or contributor supplies redacted live output showing detection selects the coding endpoint after this header change before merge.

options.title: Accept a proof override
options.body: A maintainer explicitly accepts the credential gap based on the linked issue's live before-fix proof and this PR's narrow source/test evidence.

options.title: Pause for canonical PR selection
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers choose which same-root-cause PR should become the single landing path.

recommendation.title: Require or provide live smoke proof
recommendation.body: A maintainer or contributor supplies redacted live output showing detection selects the coding endpoint after this header change before merge.
